goal: At least 10% CPU-time reserve while decoding Speex NB
method: Inject at least 32000 independently counted foreground instruction cycles in every 320000-cycle audio frame. Timer/ISR execution consumes additional wall time and stays enabled during playback. Require exact PWM, zero underruns and intact SRAM for the same complete 31-stream corpus.
scope: Measured corpus on AVR8js 0.21.1 and AVR GCC 7.3.0; additional application I/O/ISRs and physical clock timing require their own validation.
